purpose: Teach: 美少女/パラダイス/ウォーキング/トリオ/バーベキュー/ボイス/バンクーバー/愛車

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、絵本の美少女キャラ、可愛いね
lines.en: Sho, those picture-book heroines are really cute, aren't they?
lines.style: Warm, observant tone. A gentle comment made while glancing at what he's looking at. Not pressing—just noticing him noticing. Soft and unhurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お庭をパラダイスみたいにしたいよ
lines.en: Mom, I want to make the garden look like a paradise.
lines.style: Breathless with excitement, the words tumbling out. Earnest and vivid—he's already seeing it. Small voice full of vision, no self-consciousness.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと早朝ウォーキングしましょう
lines.en: Sho, how about you and Dad go for an early-morning walk together?
lines.style: Gentle suggestion, warmly offered. A light touch—not commanding, but inviting. The tone of someone creating small moments on purpose.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、合唱でトリオを組んだよ
lines.en: Mom, I formed a trio for the choir!
lines.style: Bright announcement, chest open. Pride without bragging—he's genuinely pleased and wants to share it. Quick attack on the news, then settling into the warmth of having said it.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんちでバーベキューしましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's have a barbecue at Grandpa's house, shall we?
lines.style: Warm invitation laced with gentle anticipation. Eyes bright. Speaking more to herself than just to him—painting the picture of a good day coming.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんのボイスメッセージ届いたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad's voice message came through!
lines.style: Quick, delighted delivery. The excitement of having gotten something from Dad—a small treasure. Bounces slightly in the voice without being frantic.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがバンクーバー出張から帰ってこられるのよ
lines.en: Sho, Dad's coming back from his business trip to Vancouver.
lines.style: Soft, steady voice. Not quite floating on joy—more anchored and real. A moment of gentle certainty. Slight pause before 'coming back,' as if settling him into what's true.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんの愛車、洗ったの?
lines.en: Mom, did you wash Dad's car?
lines.style: Curious, attentive question. Small voice with focus—he's noticed something matters and is checking in. Close, intimate tone like he's standing right beside her.
